records.text: Notre Dame Preparatory High School formerly operated as the Tesseract School that closed in North Scottsdale before reopening under the new name
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Well, the story goes regarding Tesseract that after they filed for bankruptcy in 2001, they put their old campus up for sale and it was. It was purchased by the Diocese of Phoenix when they then turned it into Notre Dame Prep, where Erika (Erika Kirk) then enrolls for high school.

Erika (Erika Kirk) is at Notre Dame Prep, and I should note, I did not know this at the time, but Notre Dame Prep was formerly the Tesseract School, the one that they had to shutter in North Scottsdale. Now the doors are reopened and it's Notre Dame Prep.

verification.notes: Catholic Education Arizona reports that the Diocese purchased the former Tesseract campus in March 2001 and opened Notre Dame Preparatory in August 2002. This supports the same-site succession after Tesseract closed, but not the claim that Tesseract merely reopened under a new name; Notre Dame Prep was a distinct Catholic school.

sources.title: Notre Dame Preparatory High School: Developing Strong Character
sources.relevance: Reports diocesan purchase of the former Tesseract site and the separate opening of Notre Dame Prep in 2002.

records.text: During the 2005-2006 school year Erika Kirk was a Notre Dame Prep junior and first runner-up in National American Miss Arizona, qualifying for the November 2005 All-American Miss pageant
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Anyway, let's jump into an Erika (Erika Kirk) timeline and you guys can follow along here. 2005, Erika (Erika Kirk) is still attending Notre Dame Prep and she is playing basketball. ... She was a junior in high school from 2005-2006. She is going to win first runner-up in the National American Miss Arizona pageant, and she will represent Arizona in the upcoming All-American Miss pageant in November of 2005, which takes place in Los Angeles.

verification.notes: Current biographical and pageant searches corroborate later National American Miss participation but did not locate authoritative results for the precise 2005-06 first-runner-up placement and November 2005 All-American qualification asserted here.

records.text: Erika Kirk graduated from Notre Dame Prep in 2007 with a full basketball and academic scholarship to Regis University and was an Arizona Interscholastic Association Everyday Heroes finalist
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: That is also the year that she's going to graduate from Notre Dame Prep in the spring, receiving a full basketball and academic scholarship ... to Regis University, which is in Denver, Colorado. She's also named as a finalist for the Arizona Interscholastic Association's Everyday Heroes Award.

verification.notes: Official Notre Dame Prep, Regis, and AIA records confirm a 2007 graduation, collegiate basketball participation, and Everyday Heroes finalist recognition. A contemporaneous first-person interview listing confirms a full-ride basketball and academic scholarship; because that scholarship detail is biographical rather than a published award record, overall confidence is medium.

records.text: Regis University records show Erika Kirk playing basketball only in the 2007-2008 season, despite her later claim that she played there for two years
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: she says she played basketball for two years and she's going to note in a future alumni packet of Notre Dame that she was indeed playing basketball at Regis University for two years but I I could not confirm that. ... And interestingly enough, Regis University still has her basketball stat page up and they're on my side. They say they only have a record of her playing for from 2007 to 2008.

verification.notes: Regis's official page lists Erika Frantzve on the 2008-09 roster as a sophomore but supplies game statistics only for 2007-08. Thus it is accurate that the displayed playing statistics cover one season, but inaccurate to imply the university has no second-season roster record.
